comment: Allow-list for internal/template/canonical_placeholders_corpus_test.go. Templates whose sha256 appears in 'exceptions' are exempt from the canonical-placeholder-resolution gate. Each entry MUST cite a tracking issue and SHOULD be removed once the template is repaired (the sha256 will then no longer match, restoring the gate). Use `json2pptx template-check --json <file>` (or `shasum -a 256 <file>`) to read the sha256. The list MUST be empty once go-slide-creator-vqad and its children land.

exceptions.reason: Designer template: missing Two Content, Section Divider, Blank, Blank+Title, Closing; Title Slide lacks subtitle. Repair under parent go-slide-creator-vqad.
